name: ashley_bend
title: Ashley bend
about: Joins two ropes: an overhand loop in each, the two loops interlocked like links of a chain, and both ends passed through the middle the same way, so they come out side by side on the same face. Each cord is an overhand knot, both of the same hand. Shown loose.

steps.caption: Make a loop in the end of the first cord: down from the top, round, and the end over its own standing part.
Make the same loop in the second cord, turned upside down, so that it goes over the first loop on the right and under it on the left: the two loops are linked.
Take the first cord's end down round the outside, under both lower sides and up through the middle from behind, then over both upper sides.

Take the second cord's end up round the outside, under both upper sides and through the middle from behind, then over both lower sides. Both ends come out in front; pull the standing parts apart to tighten.
